$comment: Generated from crates/luyaz-core/src/contract.rs by the test contract_schema_file_is_current (LUYAZ_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1). Levels: normal, personal (identifiers; owner and authenticated MCP see them), secret (never in plain text outside the live state), nested.

advice.description:
The experience library's word on where the device is now (u60-radio.md §7, D12):
per preference bucket how long and how many crashes/drops, crashes per band. MCC-MNC is
`normal`, as `signal`'s; no cell id, no PCI.
advice.title: Advice

ApnProfile.description:
One APN profile (`zwrt_apn_object` list entry). The password never leaves the device:
only whether one is set.

apn.description: APN (3-3): mode, the profile on cid 1, both lists.

current.description: `profileId` on cid 1 (what the data link uses)

apn.title: Apn

enabled.description: null when the vendor reports a mode other than enable/disable

connect_mode.description: "auto" on some firmware, a number on others

op.description:
E4 operation state. Its old/new values can be anything the write path touches,
so the details are secret until Phase 3 types them.
op.title: Op

FilterRule.description: One `router_get_macipport_filter_rule` entry (non-empty shape not seen on the device yet).

PortForwardRule.description: One `router_get_portforward_rule` entry (non-empty shape not seen on the device yet).

id.description: "" when the firmware gives none (then it cannot be deleted)

RouterAlg.description: `router_get_alg_para` (B31 reports only SIP ALG; null = not reported).

RouterFirewall.description: `router_get_firewall_para`. A switch is null when the firmware does not report it.

RouterQos.description: The vendor 带宽分配 mode (uci `zwrt_smart_mng`), read only.

RouterUpnp.description: `router_get_upnp`; the numbers are what `router_set_upnp_switch` takes back (null: not reported).

router.description:
Router settings (batch 4): one part per vendor read, null when that read failed or its
shape is not recognised; rule lists are [] when the firmware answers `{}`.
router.title: Router

home_mcc.description: null when the IMSI's MCC is not a known country

lte_cell_lock.description: current cell lock, raw: `pci,earfcn` (order inferred, unverified); unlocked = "" or zeros

net_select_mode.description:
how the network is chosen: "auto_select" | "manual_select" (vendor nwinfo); not the
radio preference, which is `net_select`

nr_cell_lock.description: current cell lock, raw `pci,arfcn,band` (B31); unlocked = "" or "0,0,0"

true_roaming.description: null when either country is unknown

smart_rule.description: Smart switching rule, UCI `zte_nwinfo.dsds` (absent when not set)

switching.description: `switch_card_status == "0"`: the firmware is switching on its own

at.description: device epoch seconds of the reading (device clock, see `clock.utc_offset`)

present.description: an ICCID is known for the slot (readable even when not provisioned)

ready.description: null when the slot is not provisioned (the firmware reports no state then)

role.description: "data" (the radio readings in `network` are this slot's) | "standby" | "off".

signal.description:
This slot's radio: the data slot from nwinfo, the standby slot from our own
QMI NAS client (every 30 s); absent when there is no reading.

dual.description: Dual-SIM view (全球版); left out when `support_dual_sim != 1`.

uci_device_info.description: uci values, each left out when empty.
uci_device_info.title: UciDeviceInfo

WifiBand.description: One main AP and its radio (uci `wireless`). The password never leaves the device.

WifiGuest.description: Guest Wi-Fi (`guest_2g`, the 5 GHz one shares its settings). No password, only whether one is set.

left_s.description:
seconds left (`zwrt_wlan wlan_get_guest_access_left_time`), read only while guest is on;
null otherwise or unread

wifi.description: Wi-Fi settings (batch 4) for the web pages; `wlan` stays as it is for its readers.

on.description: master switch: vendor `wifi_onoff` not "0" and not both main APs disabled

wifi6.description: `zte_mbb.wifi6_switch` not "0" (missing counts as on, as the stock page does)

wifi.title: Wifi
